sources.entry: s-cart - E-commerce website for individuals and businesses, built on top of Laravel Framework. (Demo, Source Code) MIT PHP

summary.one_liner: S-Cart is a free, open-source e-commerce platform built on Laravel and the GP247 ecosystem, providing a storefront, admin panel, and extensible plugin/template system for online shops.
summary.what_it_does: S-Cart provides an online shop with products, cart, orders, and customers, plus a CMS for categories, news, and content pages. It includes an admin panel with role-based permissions, an activity log, and CAPTCHA. The README lists multi-language and multi-currency support, payment plugins, shipping methods, discount codes, and tax calculation. It can be extended with HMVC plugins, templates, and a secured API for mobile apps, and it offers an MCP Server plugin for connecting AI agents to the shop. Setup is covered by Composer, Git clone, or Docker, with artisan commands for install, updates, plugin and template scaffolding, and diagnostics.
use_cases: run an online store for a small business
build a custom e-commerce site on Laravel
manage products, orders and customers in an admin panel
create plugins or templates for an online shop
connect AI assistants to store data via MCP
learn e-commerce development with an open-source codebase
how_to_run: Edit .env database settings (DB_HOST, DB_DATABASE, DB_USERNAME, DB_PASSWORD)
Open the storefront and admin in a browser; change the default admin password after first login
notable: Installable via Composer, Git clone, or Docker with separate dev and prod compose files
Optional MCP Server plugin lets AI agents query shop data with token security and logging
Plugin and template scaffolding commands, with a controller override mechanism for customization
Update command (gp247:update) designed to keep data and edited templates
Pro plugins for multi-vendor, multi-store, and InOut accounting
caveats: Requires PHP 8.3 or newer; older PHP silently installs an old 1.x version unless the ^3.0 constraint is used
Table prefix (GP247_DB_PREFIX) cannot be changed after installation
Multi-vendor, multi-store, and InOut are paid Pro plugins
